summary: This directory contains unit tests for internal logic related to processing and rendering JSDoc comments during update operations, ensuring the correctness of the documentation generation utilities.
responsibilities: Verify the construction of JSDoc update contexts
Validate the rendering of JSDoc line formatting
Confirm the generation of JSDoc string representations
relationships: The JSDoc update context provides the necessary data structure for the rendering logic to produce correctly formatted documentation strings.
designDecisions: Colocation of unit tests within an internal subdirectory to maintain separation from public-facing interfaces
Isolated verification of rendering logic before integration into larger update workflows
